question: Сколько скважин в статусе producing?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wells WHERE status = 'producing';

question: Контракты на продажу в статусе active
gold_sql: SELECT contract_number, buyer_id, volume_bbl, price_per_bbl FROM sales_contracts WHERE status = 'active';

question: Затраты по месторождениям за 2024 год
gold_sql: SELECT f.field_name, SUM(oc.amount_usd) FROM operating_costs oc JOIN fields f ON oc.field_id = f.field_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oc.cost_date) = 2024 GROUP BY f.field_id;

question: Средний GOR по скважинам
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, AVG(rd.GOR_scf_bbl) FROM reservoir_data rd JOIN wells w ON rd.well_id = w.well_id WHERE rd.GOR_scf_bbl IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.well_id;

question: Инциденты безопасности с severity high за 2023
gold_sql: SELECT incident_date, incident_type, field_id, lost_time_days FROM safety_incidents WHERE severity = 'high' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM incident_date) = 2023;

question: Затраты по категориям за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT cost_category, SUM(amount_usd) FROM operating_costs WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cost_date) = 2024 GROUP BY cost_category;

question: Reservoir data с water_cut более 50%
gold_sql: SELECT field_id, well_id, data_date, water_cut_percent FROM reservoir_data WHERE water_cut_percent > 50;

question: Liftings по контрактам за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT sc.contract_number, SUM(l.volume_bbl), SUM(l.volume_bbl * l.price_per_bbl) FROM liftings l JOIN sales_contracts sc ON l.contract_id = sc.contract_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.lifting_date) = 2024 GROUP BY sc.contract_id;

question: Сотрудники с зарплатой более 150000 usd
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, position, salary_usd FROM employees WHERE salary_usd > 150000;

question: Добыча газа по месторождениям за 2023
gold_sql: SELECT f.field_name, SUM(fp.gas_mcf) FROM field_production fp JOIN fields f ON fp.field_id = f.field_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fp.record_date) = 2023 GROUP BY f.field_id;

question: Трубопроводы типа oil
gold_sql: SELECT pipeline_name, origin_field_id, capacity_bopd FROM pipelines WHERE pipeline_type = 'oil';

question: Буровые операции с cost более 1 млн
gold_sql: SELECT well_id, operation_date, operation_type, cost_usd FROM drilling_operations WHERE cost_usd > 1000000;

question: Среднее давление в пласте по скважинам
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, AVG(rd.pressure_psi) FROM reservoir_data rd JOIN wells w ON rd.well_id = w.well_id WHERE rd.pressure_psi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.well_id;

question: Платформы с capacity более 50000 bopd
gold_sql: SELECT platform_name, capacity_bopd, field_id FROM platforms WHERE capacity_bopd > 50000;

question: Затраты maintenance за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM operating_costs WHERE cost_category = 'maintenance' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cost_date) = 2024;

question: Скважины по типам
gold_sql: SELECT wt.type_name, COUNT(w.well_id) FROM wells w JOIN well_types wt ON w.well_type_id = wt.well_type_id GROUP BY wt.well_type_id;

question: Liftings с price_per_bbl более 80
gold_sql: SELECT lifting_date, volume_bbl, price_per_bbl FROM liftings WHERE price_per_bbl > 80;

question: Месторождения в статусе production
gold_sql: SELECT field_name, estimated_reserves_mboe, region_id FROM fields WHERE status = 'production';

question: Добыча воды по скважинам за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, SUM(pr.water_bbl) FROM production_records pr JOIN wells w ON pr.well_id = w.well_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.record_date) = 2024 GROUP BY w.well_id;

question: Буровые кампании с budget более 50 млн
gold_sql: SELECT campaign_name, field_id, budget_usd FROM drilling_campaigns WHERE budget_usd > 50000000;

question: Трубопроводы с length более 200 км
gold_sql: SELECT pipeline_name, length_km, capacity_bopd FROM pipelines WHERE length_km > 200;

question: Добыча по кварталам 2024
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM record_date) as quarter, SUM(oil_bbl), SUM(gas_mcf) FROM production_records WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM record_date) = 2024 GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM record_date);

question: Платформы по месторождениям
gold_sql: SELECT f.field_name, COUNT(p.platform_id) FROM platforms p JOIN fields f ON p.field_id = f.field_id GROUP BY f.field_id;

question: Топ-5 покупателей по объёму liftings
gold_sql: SELECT b.buyer_name, SUM(l.volume_bbl) FROM liftings l JOIN sales_contracts sc ON l.contract_id = sc.contract_id JOIN buyers b ON sc.buyer_id = b.buyer_id GROUP BY b.buyer_id ORDER BY SUM(l.volume_bbl) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Drilling operations по operation_type
gold_sql: SELECT operation_type, COUNT(*), SUM(cost_usd) FROM drilling_operations GROUP BY operation_type;

question: Скважины injection
gold_sql: SELECT well_name, field_id FROM wells WHERE status = 'injection';

question: Reservoir data с pressure менее 3000 psi
gold_sql: SELECT field_id, well_id, pressure_psi, data_date FROM reservoir_data WHERE pressure_psi < 3000;

question: Контракты с volume более 500000 bbl
gold_sql: SELECT contract_number, volume_bbl, price_per_bbl FROM sales_contracts WHERE volume_bbl > 500000;

question: Сотрудники на платформе
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, p.platform_name FROM employees e JOIN platforms p ON e.platform_id = p.platform_id;

question: Добыча по скважинам за 2023
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, SUM(pr.oil_bbl), SUM(pr.gas_mcf) FROM production_records pr JOIN wells w ON pr.well_id = w.well_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.record_date) = 2023 GROUP BY w.well_id;

question: Инциденты на платформах
gold_sql: SELECT p.platform_name, si.incident_type, si.incident_date FROM safety_incidents si JOIN platforms p ON si.platform_id = p.platform_id;

question: Liftings по месяцам 2024
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM lifting_date) as month, SUM(volume_bbl), SUM(volume_bbl * price_per_bbl) FROM liftings WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lifting_date) = 2024 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM lifting_date);

question: Буровые кампании completed
gold_sql: SELECT campaign_name, field_id, start_date, end_date FROM drilling_campaigns WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Water cut по скважинам
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, AVG(rd.water_cut_percent) FROM reservoir_data rd JOIN wells w ON rd.well_id = w.well_id WHERE rd.water_cut_percent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.well_id;

question: Затраты по скважинам и платформам
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, p.platform_name, SUM(oc.amount_usd) FROM operating_costs oc LEFT JOIN wells w ON oc.well_id = w.well_id LEFT JOIN platforms p ON oc.platform_id = p.platform_id WHERE oc.well_id IS NOT NULL OR oc.platform_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.well_name, p.platform_name;

question: Скважины abandoned
gold_sql: SELECT well_name, field_id, depth_m FROM wells WHERE status = 'abandoned';

question: Добыча с downtime более 24 часов за месяц
gold_sql: SELECT w.well_name, pr.record_date, pr.downtime_hours FROM production_records pr JOIN wells w ON pr.well_id = w.well_id WHERE pr.downtime_hours > 24;

question: Сотрудники по отделам
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department;

question: Трубопроводы в статусе maintenance
gold_sql: SELECT pipeline_name, pipeline_type FROM pipelines WHERE status = 'maintenance';

question: Liftings с vessel_name
gold_sql: SELECT lifting_date, volume_bbl, vessel_name FROM liftings WHERE vessel_name IS NOT NULL;

question: Затраты logistics за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM operating_costs WHERE cost_category = 'logistics' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cost_date) = 2024;

question: Инциденты environmental
gold_sql: SELECT incident_date, field_id, description FROM safety_incidents WHERE incident_type = 'environmental';

question: Средний price_per_bbl по покупателям
gold_sql: SELECT b.buyer_name, AVG(l.price_per_bbl) FROM liftings l JOIN sales_contracts sc ON l.contract_id = sc.contract_id JOIN buyers b ON sc.buyer_id = b.buyer_id GROUP BY b.buyer_id;

question: Резервуары с уровнем менее 20%
gold_sql: SELECT tank_name, current_level_bbl, capacity_bbl FROM storage_tanks WHERE (current_level_bbl/capacity_bbl) < 0.2 AND status = 'active';

question: Буровые операции с contractor
gold_sql: SELECT operation_date, operation_type, contractor, cost_usd FROM drilling_operations WHERE contractor IS NOT NULL;

question: Контракты на gas
gold_sql: SELECT contract_number, volume_bbl, buyer_id FROM sales_contracts WHERE product_type = 'gas';

question: Инциденты с lost_time_days более 10
gold_sql: SELECT incident_date, incident_type, lost_time_days, field_id FROM safety_incidents WHERE lost_time_days > 10;

question: Сотрудники, принятые в 2022
gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date, position FROM employees WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = 2022;

question: Общая выручка от liftings по годам
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lifting_date) as year, SUM(volume_bbl * price_per_bbl) FROM liftings GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM lifting_date);

question: Месторождения с наибольшей добычей за 2024
gold_sql: SELECT f.field_name, SUM(fp.oil_bbl) as total_oil FROM field_production fp JOIN fields f ON fp.field_id = f.field_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fp.record_date) = 2024 GROUP BY f.field_id ORDER BY total_oil DESC LIMIT 5;
